tracks.title: The Bed's Too Big Without You

verdict.text: Discogs doesn't know when this was pressed

notes.text:
This version has text immediately underneath the track list on the sleeve rear, with January 21th (sic) 1980 mention.
It also has no art direction credits, or cover photography credits along the very bottom of the sleeve.

Similar releases with price codes CB 271 and 57 on back cover:
[This release]: back cover: text underneath tracks, no credits at the bottom of the sleeve
: pressed by CBS Haarlem, ⓤ in runout
: pressed by CBS Haarlem, hype 'sticker' printed
: cut at Strawberry Mastering by tone
: mastered at Sheffield Lab Matrix, Interpol on label, long rim text
: mastered at Sheffield Lab Matrix, Interpol on label, shorter rim text
: mastered at Sheffield Lab Matrix, rights society BIEM/STEMRA. SLM cut on one side.
: mastered at Sheffield Lab Matrix, rights society BIEM/STEMRA. SLM cut on both sides.
